faq_heading: Homes near Earl Marriott Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Earl Marriott Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Earl Marriott Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Earl Marriott Secondary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Earl Marriott Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Peace Arch Elementary (0.7 km south), South Meridian Elementary (1.1 km south-east) and Jessie Lee Elementary (1.2 km north-west).

Earl Marriott Secondary is a secondary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 15751 16 Ave. It teaches grades 8 to 12. Programs listed: Secondary French Immersion.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Earl Marriott Secondary.
How the Earl Marriott Secondary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Earl Marriott Secondary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit some distance away. Ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Earl Marriott Secondary

13 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Earl Marriott Secondary in a straight line (8 elementary, 3 other, 2 secondary; 5 independent). The closest is Peace Arch Elementary, 0.7 km away, and the farthest on this list is Sunnyside Elementary, 2.5 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is St John Paul II Academy (1.4 km); the nearest independent school is Newbridge Academy (1.3 km). Other secondary schools close by: St John Paul II Academy (1.4 km south-west), Semiahmoo Secondary (2.1 km west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (8-12) is St John Paul II Academy, 1.4 km south-west of Earl Marriott Secondary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Earl Marriott Secondary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Earl Marriott Secondary can sit in a different catchment.
Go past Earl Marriott Secondary on a school morning and again mid-afternoon to see the traffic, parking and noise before you offer.
Look at St John Paul II Academy, the nearest other secondary school, 1.4 km south-west of Earl Marriott Secondary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
